assessments.reasoning: The cover and inner title name the Carnegie language manual. Its preface identifies a local realization, and the introduction separates language differences from system statements used to control the translator.

challenge.method: Compare the January-dated preface, the February 1965 inner title, and the February 1964 printing note.
challenge.results: The cover, inner title and preface bind the documentary identity. The printing note has a narrower function and an earlier date. The librarian, libraries, assembler and translator remain separately described components.

limitations: The cited scope is the February 1965 language manual. It does not describe the entire local software suite.
